developing an e-voting protocol that is simple, secure, and convenient for the voter.

our protocol is simple, cast-as-intended, and convenient to use.

the protocol is simple, yet secure, and can be implemented using secure hardware tokens (like ID-cards) that are widely available.
we have designed and implemented an e-voting protocol that is simple, secure, convenient and practical.

it is not necessary to use a complicated and expensive e-voting system (like the one used in Estonia) to achieve the same level of security.
the use of secure smart cards can significantly increase the security of e-voting, while keeping the usability and the cost of the protocol at a very acceptable level.
it is possible to develop a secure and convenient cast-as-intended e-voting protocol without relying on any cryptographic assumptions.
